advisories.class: DoS (Image Optimizer remotePatterns; HTTP request deserialization)
advisories.reason: Framework-level. The only fix is a Next 16 MAJOR upgrade (isSemVerMajor) from the current 14.2.x — a breaking change needing a human decision + full regression pass; not safe to apply autonomously. DoS-class, not RCE/data-leak. Mitigations: app does not expose the Image Optimizer to untrusted remotePatterns.
